answers.description: Fenwick Associates is a two-person management consultancy in Durham that helps owner-managed firms get ready to sell, or to hand over to the next generation. We start with a plain review of how the business runs, then stay alongside the owners through valuation, tidying up the paperwork, finding the right buyer and the first year after the deal. Most of our work comes from accountants who know us.
